wholeGoal.title: Individuelle Verdauungs- und Resorptionsunterschiede begründen
wholeGoal.titleEn: Justify individual differences in digestion and resorption
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann genetisch bedingte oder erworbene individuelle Unterschiede bei Verdauung und Resorption von Nahrungsbestandteilen chemisch begründen.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can chemically justify genetically caused or acquired individual differences in digestion and resorption of food components.

resourceLinks.provider: OpenAI / ChatGPT-Codex built-in image_gen (model version not exposed)
resourceLinks.description: Comicartiger Vergleich der enzymatischen Lactosespaltung mit und ohne Lactase. Die Darmsymbole stehen allgemein für den Verdauungstrakt; die Abbildung ist kein anatomischer Lageplan oder klinischer Befund.
resourceLinks.altText: Mit Lactase wird die schematische Lactose in zwei Einfachzucker gespalten; ohne Lactase bleibt sie verbunden. Darmsymbole veranschaulichen den Verdauungstrakt.

caseFindings.reason: Two individuals differ only in lactase activity. Lower activity limits lactose hydrolysis to glucose and galactose and hence the production of those monosaccharides available for uptake. This does not say enzyme action itself transports the products across the intestinal wall. No measured individual result is claimed.

caseFindings.judgment: Scientifically sound independent transfer within this model scope.
caseFindings.reason: The supplied second model stipulates monosaccharide formation and reduced intestinal transport. The learner must locate the limitation after cleavage, contrasting it with the first enzyme-limited case. Reduced transport and insufficient cleavage are distinguishable mechanisms and do not imply each other.

records.wholeProfileCoverage: The retained v2 profile is content-identical to v1 and requires chemical mechanism plus fresh transfer. These cases support those expectations at the design level. The final scoring requires chemically justified links and limits, rather than merely naming lactase or resorption.
records.geneticAcquiredBoundary: The task model stipulates changed activity/transport. It can explain downstream chemical consequences of an individual difference whether genetic or acquired; it cannot infer which origin applies to an individual. The generic expected sentence that changes may affect different steps is not evidence that a learner has established a specific genetic or acquired cause. No gene variant, mucosal injury, observed patient data or diagnostic conclusion is invented or certified.
records.wholeGoalApplicability: The current target asks chemical reasoning about individual differences, without requiring a genetic diagnostic procedure, actual medical investigation or an experiment performed by the learner. The supplied mechanism comparison is appropriate to that literal scope. Upstream molecular genetic detail and individual aetiology remain outside this design claim.
records.contextAndFormat: Current whole text and own requires match the author body. Digestive-juice and enzyme-reaction prerequisites provide chemical context; the image link is the only body difference and cannot prove P. Both DE/EN tasks and rubrics retain the same mechanism and transfer boundaries.
records.executionStatus: Conceptual task models only; no lab execution, medical advice or actual learner work.
records.sourceBoundary: The bounded BY NTG clause is read. Inherited source membership is not a whole-jurisdiction or track approval.

wholeGoal.title: Optische Aktivität und Polarimetrie auswerten
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann optische Aktivität chiraler Naturstoffe erläutern, den spezifischen Drehwinkel als Kenneigenschaft beschreiben und Polarimetrie zur Charakterisierung optisch aktiver Substanzen fachlich einordnen.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can explain optical activity of chiral natural substances, describe specific rotation as a characteristic property, and classify polarimetry for characterizing optically active substances.

caseFindings.reason: The explicitly supplied alpha = [alpha]lc convention gives +6/(2*0.05) = +60 degree mL/(g dm). Temperature, wavelength and solvent must be matched for comparisons; the positive sign does not establish D configuration. The task asks a supplied-data evaluation, not actual measurement.

Under the same achiral measurement conditions and a linear/additive solution model, corresponding enantiomers rotate equally and oppositely; an equimolar racemate has zero net rotation. Zero does not uniquely prove racemic composition or chemical identity, and can have other causes. Same conditions are an essential comparison boundary, not a universal solvent-independent equality.

caseFindings.judgment: Calculation is correct; the mandatory reference identification remains materially ambiguous.
caseFindings.reason: The supplied alpha +5.3 degrees, l = 1.00 dm and c = 0.100 g/mL give [alpha] = +53 degree mL/(g dm). But the material labels glucose +52.7 degrees and fructose -92.4 degrees only as references under the same conditions. It never identifies those numbers as specific rotations or supplies their corresponding convention/units. The model answer treats them as specific rotations. If read as observed rotations under the stated l/c, their normalized values are +527 and -924, and +5.3 degrees does not match either observed reference. Conventional suppression of units is acceptable only once the reference quantity is clear; this task omits that distinction.
caseFindings.retainedGoodDesign: Identifying only among two stated candidates, and rejecting universal identity/purity claims from a single rotation, is a good bounded approach. If the intended references are explicitly specific rotations, predicted observed glucose +5.27 degrees rounds to the model +5.3 degrees, and the intended reasoning is sound.

records.wholeProfileCoverage: The latest v2 profile requires a third execution expectation and embeds execution-1. The four-case image-context extract and old two-case v1 profile cannot silently replace that latest route to claim full P. The valid original two cases remain valid science; no old review is rewritten.
records.neededBoundedRemedy: Explicitly label the two reference values as specific rotations under a named concentration/path convention and matched conditions, or supply observed reference angles under the stated l/c. Preserve the supplied-data model and its candidate/uncertainty/equilibrium limits. Review only that changed case and profile counterpart; do not invent a real measurement.
records.practicalBoundary: Despite its execution-1 ID, this is a supplied model reading and calculation. No instrument operation, calibration, blank, raw learner measurement or laboratory acquisition is supplied or claimed. The current goal does not itself demand actual instrument execution. The generic rubric sentence about practical steps is not proof of execution.
records.contextAndFormat: The unchanged current body/prerequisites and the good schematic image do not cure the reference-quantity ambiguity. A DE/EN substantive parity defect is not asserted; both languages have the same ambiguity.
